associations.rationale: The equality directly expresses the Specht-module character as the indicated Laurent coefficient, which is the claimed equivalent Frobenius-character formula.
This general coefficient-conversion identity relates the Laurent expression to a Vandermonde coefficient and supports the equivalence, but does not itself state the character formula.
This monomial-factor identity is a helper for rewriting the Laurent product and does not itself identify the Frobenius character coefficient.
